description: Sends an incoming phasor to side A or side B at random, re-choosing at the start of every cycle

params.text: The chance used at each phasor reset, 0 to 1, at 0.5 by default; the MODE setting fixes what that chance applies to
Scales the PROBABILITY CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
Steps through three ways of choosing: B PROB gives B the chance and A whatever is left over, ALTERNATE flips B's state when the chance comes up, INDEPENDENT rolls A and B separately

inputs.text: The phasor to be split; its wrap back to the start re-rolls the choice
Modulates the probability, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob

outputs.text: The incoming phasor, 0-10V, while A is the chosen side, and 0V the rest of the time
10V over the first half of each cycle while A is the chosen side, and 0V the rest of the time
The incoming phasor, 0-10V, while B is the chosen side, and 0V the rest of the time
10V over the first half of each cycle while B is the chosen side, and 0V the rest of the time

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
